espn-604011.headline: Italy get Fiji again, this time for 11th place
beats: In Udine on 21 November, Italy led 13–7 at half-time and lost 21–16. Tevita Ikanivere scored twice as Fiji came from behind for their first Nations Championship win. The rematch is the 11th-place final, at Allianz Stadium in London, with Italy the home side.

Italy have lost seven straight, including 66 conceded to South Africa. Their last two defeats were by five points each. Fiji shipped 54 to France and 43 to Ireland before they found Udine more agreeable.

Gonzalo Quesada put the gap at ten kilos a man. Giacomo Nicotera says the Italian scrum is becoming a weapon, and a scrum is where ten kilos usually tells. Win and Italy go above Fiji in the world rankings.
Italy's next game is Scotland in February. Fiji's is Spain at the World Cup in October 2027, which is a long time to sit on this result.

espn-604012.headline: Australia missed the last kick in July. They get another
beats: In Sydney on 4 July, Thomas Clarkson's late try, converted by Sam Prendergast, put Ireland 33–31 ahead, and Ben Donaldson missed a penalty with the final kick. The rematch is the fifth-place final of the Nations Championship, at Allianz Stadium in London.
Ireland arrive on three straight wins, the last 20–17 over South Africa, and still finished third in the North. Australia beat Wales 29–26 to get here, a week after losing to Scotland by three.

Les Kiss, once Ireland's defence coach and later Ulster's boss, took over Australia this year, so he knows what he is up against. Win, and Ireland climb to third in the world while Australia drop to eighth, below Argentina.
Ireland have England at home in February. Australia's next Test is Hong Kong at the World Cup, which is a long time to replay a last kick.

espn-604013.headline: Japan get another go at Wales, 145 points later
beats: On 7 November Japan lost 21–28 in Cardiff, done by Josh Adams's 69th-minute try and his last-minute ruck penalty. Since then they have conceded 78 to England and 67 to Scotland, scoring 20.

Wales beat New Zealand the week after Japan, then lost 26–29 to Australia, four tries each, settled by a Gordon penalty five minutes from time. Captain Dewi Lake scored twice from lineouts. Wales spent the rest of the game wasting chances.

This is the ninth-place final. Wales are the home side, in London. Japan need to win by 16 or more to go above Wales in the world rankings, a margin they have only ever seen from the other end lately.
Wales go to France in February. Japan have nothing scheduled, so whatever happens here, they keep it for a while.

espn-604014.headline: A week after 37–12, New Zealand need 16 to go top
beats: England's 25-point margin on 21 November was their biggest ever against New Zealand, who had never lost by a wider margin to a northern-hemisphere side. The two meet again on the same ground at Allianz Stadium, this time in the third-place final.
England arrive on five straight wins, with 13 tries against Japan along the way. New Zealand have conceded 72 points in their last two games, to Wales and then England.
Ben Earl carried 33 times for 138 metres last Saturday. Win by 16 or more and New Zealand go above South Africa to first in the world, which would be a long way to travel in seven days.
England's next Test is in Ireland in February. The last time they beat New Zealand in November, a dismal Six Nations followed.

espn-604015.headline: Opening act for the final, with sixth place on the bill
beats: Scotland and Argentina play for seventh place in the Nations Championship on Sunday 29 November. It is the game before France and South Africa contest the final on the same ground. Argentina can take home more than a placing: win by 16 or more and they go above Scotland to sixth in the world.

Sixteen is a lot for a side that conceded 42 to Ireland and 45 to France this month, with France scoring five of their seven tries after half-time. Scotland put 67 on Japan last time out and let in five.
The sides met in Cordoba in July and shared 85 points. Scotland won 47–38, with hooker Gregor Hiddleston scoring a try on debut. Argentina scored 38 at home and still lost by nine.
Scotland are back for Italy in February. Argentina's next game is Canada at the World Cup next October, which leaves them a long time to think about this one.

espn-604016.headline: South Africa lost by two, then got the rematch
beats: France beat South Africa 21–19 on 13 November. They meet again at Allianz Stadium in London, this time for the inaugural Nations Championship title.

South Africa then lost 17–20 in Dublin. The losing bonus point from that defeat is what kept them above New Zealand at the top of the South. Two defeats by five points in all, and they are in the final.

France arrive on five straight wins but needed the second half to put away Argentina, 45–17. Kalvin Gourgues said they lost their duels in every collision early on. Win by 16 or more and France go to 1st in the world, above South Africa.
Fabien Galthié has since said coaches must choose their words carefully about referees, a remark aimed at Rassie Erasmus. A two-point margin tends to keep that conversation going.
